UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores core information about a user profile, linking to an external authentication system and enabling personalized app experiences.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

externalAuthUserId.description: Unique identifier for the user provided by the external authentication system. This links the internal UserProfile to the authenticated user. (Relationship: External Auth System 1:1 UserProfile)

email.description: The user's email address, typically obtained from the external authentication system.

displayName.description: The user's preferred display name for the application.

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's profile picture.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the user profile was updated.

AnalysisResult.title: AnalysisResult
AnalysisResult.description: Stores the details and outcomes of an AI analysis performed by a user, including input and AI-generated response.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AnalysisResult entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who initiated and owns this analysis result. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N AnalysisResult)

analysisType.description: The type of analysis performed. Expected values are 'text' for text-based input analysis (e.g., food descriptions, symptoms) or 'image' for image-based input analysis (e.g., food labels, symptom photos).

inputDescription.description: The textual input provided by the user for analysis, or a descriptive text for the image input (e.g., 'photo of dog rash').

inputDataRef.description: Optional reference (e.g., a URL to a cloud storage location) to the raw input data, such as an uploaded image file. Applicable primarily for image analysis.

aiResponse.description: The detailed report, analysis, suggestions, or potential diagnoses generated by the AI in response to the user's input.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the AI analysis was performed and this result was generated.

definition.description: Stores core information about a user profile. The document ID (`userId`) must match the Firebase Authentication UID (`request.auth.uid`) for direct ownership. Includes standard user profile fields.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the UserProfile, corresponding to the Firebase Authentication UID of the logged-in user.

definition.description: Stores the details and outcomes of an AI analysis performed by a user. This is a subcollection under a specific user's profile. Includes a denormalized 'userId' field for authorization independence, ensuring the document owner is explicit without needing parent lookups.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the UserProfile who owns this analysis result, matching the parent collection's wildcard and the 'userId' field within the document.

params.name: analysisResultId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific analysis result.

firestore.reasoning: The recommended Firestore structure is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence and supporting Query-as-a-Principal (QAP) principles, critical for secure and scalable applications.
